description: This file is a server entry point for a Remix-based web application. It handles incoming HTTP requests, determines if the request is from a bot or browser, and then performs server-side rendering of the React components via streaming methods, setting appropriate headers and response status codes.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function that handles incoming requests, sets CORS headers, checks for preflight OPTIONS requests, and delegates to either handleBotRequest or handleBrowserRequest based on user-agent.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests, streaming the rendered React component to the response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests, streaming the rendered React component to the response.
